person: Leonor Vaz Okonkwo, freelance film sound editor at Estúdio Sal Grosso, lives in Graça, Lisbon; plays bass in the gigging band Maré Vazia

mail.subject: Farol – post schedule v3
mail.body: Morning Leonor, schedule v3 is on the server. Dialogue lock is in 9 days, foley starts the Friday after, and the final mix kicks off in 15 days on Sala Tejo for three days. Producer playback is the Friday after the mix. Shout if any of it clashes with your gigs. K

mail.subject: Maré Vazia at Gaivota – confirmed
mail.body: Olá! You're confirmed for Saturday week. Load-in from 18:30, soundcheck 19:00–19:45, doors 21:30, your set at 22:30 for 60 minutes. Fee is €400 for the band plus a €60 drinks tab. Guest list is 8 names max, send them to me by the Thursday before. Marta

mail.subject: Your October electricity bill
mail.body: Hello Leonor Vaz Okonkwo, your October bill is €67.40. Please pay by Multibanco within 11 days of this email: entity 21877, reference 418 552 903. Late payment adds a €5 fee.

mail.subject: Your bass amp – diagnosis
mail.body: Hi Leonor, your bass head has a failed output valve and a scratchy gain pot. Repair is €85 for parts and labour. Reply OK and it'll be ready in about a week. Bernardo

mail.subject: Your amp is ready
mail.body: Good news, the amp is repaired and tested. Total €85, card or cash. We're open weekdays 10:00–19:00 and closed at weekends. Ask for Bernardo.

mail.subject: Booking CR-55120 confirmed
mail.body: Thanks Leonor. Vehicle: 9-seat minibus with rear cargo space. Pickup in 17 days at 15:00 from Rua de Xabregas 41; return two days later by 12:00. Rental €180, plus a €250 deposit held on your card. Late returns are charged €30 for each hour started. Bring your driving licence.

mail.subject: Ruído do Rio – artist info pack
mail.body: Hi Maré Vazia! You're on Palco Margem at 17:40 for a 45-minute set, 17 days from today. Artist wristbands are at the artist gate from 14:00 on the day, bring ID. One vehicle pass per band, reply with the plate. Guest list is 4 names per band and closes 3 days before the festival. Fee €900, paid by bank transfer within 30 days of the show.

mail.subject: Notes on reel 4 dialogue
mail.body: Leonor, loved the restaurant clean-up. Two notes: the line at 04:12:30 is still muddy under the traffic, and we lose Mateus's whisper at the lighthouse door. Can we ADR both? J

mail.subject: ADR booked
mail.body: Booked Mateus for ADR in 6 days, 14:00–17:00 in Booth B. Please get me the cue list the day before by 5pm so I can prep the booth.

mail.subject: Order CC-30771 received
mail.body: Thanks for your order: 2 sets of nickel roundwound bass strings 45–105 at €29.90 each and 1 strap lock set at €12.50. Total €72.30, shipping free. We'll email when it ships.

mail.subject: Your order has shipped
mail.body: Order CC-30771 is on its way with Correio Veloz, tracking CV 8812 4409 PT. Expected delivery in 3 to 4 working days.

mail.subject: Your parcel arrives today
mail.body: Parcel CV 8812 4409 PT will be delivered today between 13:00 and 16:00. If nobody is home it goes to the pickup point at Papelaria Rosa, Rua da Graça 112, for 7 days.

mail.subject: Your check-up is booked
mail.body: Dear Leonor, this confirms your check-up and cleaning with Dra. Halima Correia. The cost is €55, payable at reception. Please arrive 10 minutes early and bring your health card.

mail.subject: setlist for gaivota
mail.body: ok here's what i'm thinking: open with Sal na Boca, then Vento Sul, Lisboa às Três, the new one (Faróis), Cais, Noite Longa, and close with Maré. about 55 min. leonor can you take the intro on Faróis? and can someone print copies for everyone

mail.subject: van for the festival
mail.body: Thanks for booking the van! I'll drive, my licence covers 9 seats. I'll meet you at the pickup. Can we split the €180 rental four ways?

mail.subject: Sal e Pedra – spotting session
mail.body: Hi Leonor, so glad you're on the doc. Can we do the spotting session Wednesday week at 12:30 on video? Tiago will join. The sound edit budget is €3,200 for 12 days of work, starting early next month.

mail.subject: almoço domingo
mail.body: Filha, lunch on Sunday at 1pm as usual? I'm making bacalhau. Bring back the tupperware I left with you last time. Your brother can't come, he's working. Beijinhos, Mãe

mail.subject: Re: Farol – foley prep
mail.body: Benedita wants the footsteps list and the props list before Friday's foley session. Can you be in by 9:30 to help her set up the stage?

mail.subject: keys rig for saturday
mail.body: Heads up, my keyboard stand broke so I'm borrowing one, which means I need to be at Gaivota by 18:00 to build it. Also Bruno says he can lend you his spare DI box, just ask him.

mail.subject: Your rehearsal bookings
mail.body: Confirmed for Maré Vazia: Thursday 19:30–22:30 and the following Thursday 19:30–22:30, both in Room 3. Rate is €15 per hour. Your 10-session block runs out after these two, renew by replying or at the desk.

mail.subject: Sala Tejo – mix prep
mail.body: Hi Leonor, ahead of Monday please have the dialogue, FX and foley predubs on the Tejo server by Sunday night. We start at 9 sharp. Lunch is provided on every mix day.

mail.subject: Re: ADR booked
mail.body: Thanks! I can only be there for the first hour of ADR, then I have a grading session. Mateus is nervous about the whisper line, be gentle :)

mail.subject: climbing tmrw?
mail.body: Still on for climbing tomorrow at 20:30? I'll bring the spare harness. And dinner on Friday with Bruno is at Tasca do Pátio, I booked under my name.

mail.subject: Your pass is nearly used up
mail.body: Hi Leonor, your 10-visit pass has 1 visit left. Renew for €75 for 10 visits, or switch to €48 a month unlimited.

mail.subject: Producer playback
mail.body: Dear all, the producer playback is set for Friday the week after next, 10:00 at Sala Tejo. Two distributors will attend, so please be in by 9:30.

mail.subject: Your tickets: Lisboa – Porto
mail.body: Booking ref CA7Q2K. Outbound in 23 days: Lisboa Santa Apolónia 07:15 → Porto Campanhã 10:05, coach 4 seat 62. Return the next day: Porto Campanhã 16:40 → Lisboa Santa Apolónia 19:30, coach 2 seat 18. Total €61.80.

mail.subject: O Último Eléctrico – screening and accreditation
mail.body: Congratulations, your film screens in competition in 20 days at 18:00, Cinema Ribeira Velha. Crew accreditation is collected at the festival hub, Rua das Flores 80, between 10:00 and 17:00. There's a Q&A after the screening and the sound team is welcome on stage.

mail.subject: Porto!
mail.body: We're in! I'm driving up the day before so I'll meet you at the cinema. Dinner after the Q&A?

mail.subject: Boiler and rent
mail.body: Bom dia Leonor, a technician will check the boiler in 9 days, between 9 and 11 in the morning. Someone needs to be in to open the door. Rent stays at €780, due at the start of the month as usual.

mail.subject: Your physio session
mail.body: We've booked your physiotherapy session with Ana Lusamba for a week on Sunday at 10:00. 45 minutes, €40. Please wear comfortable clothes.

mail.subject: props for friday
mail.body: Leonor, I've got coats, keys, the gravel pit and a rusty door. Do we need a bicycle? Someone wheels one in the lighthouse scene. The foley stage is booked until 18:00 and overtime is €70 an hour.

mail.subject: gaivota!
mail.body: Coming to the Gaivota gig! Put me on the list plus one please.

mail.subject: festival guest list?
mail.body: Hey! Any chance of a spot on your guest list for Ruído do Rio? Just me. Would love to see you play.

mail.subject: Card payment
mail.body: A payment of €72.30 to Cordas & Cia was made with your card ending 4471.

mail.subject: This week: ten basslines that shaped Lisbon
mail.body: Plus: how to stop your low end turning to mud in small rooms, and a reader's guide to cheap DI boxes.

mail.subject: Before your pickup
mail.body: Your pickup is coming up. The driver must have held a licence for at least 2 years and be present at pickup, and please bring the card used to book.

mail.subject: change of plan
mail.body: Sorry! Can we make climbing 21:00 instead of 20:30? Stuck at the office. Spare harness is in my car.

mail.subject: Remittance advice
mail.body: Payment of €2,150 for invoice SG-0412 (October) has been sent to your account. It should arrive within 2 working days.

mail.subject: faróis demo
mail.body: Uploaded the Faróis demo to the band folder. The bass part from 1:20 is just a placeholder, go wild.

mail.subject: Re: guest list
mail.body: Got your names, thanks: Bruno plus one, Sofia, and Abena. That's 4 of your 8. Our sound guy Jorge would like your stage plot before you arrive.
